query: Which machines are at risk of failure in the next 48 hours?

key_facts: Should check degradation state for all machines with low health index
Machines with RUL < 48 hours should be flagged
Should prioritize by criticality rating (A machines first)

query: Press 1 MTTR has been increasing. Why are repairs taking longer?

key_facts: Should analyze recent repair records for duration breakdown
Common causes: spare parts unavailability, technician skill gap, equipment access issues
Should check if spare parts are in stock (reference ISSUE-2025-003 spare parts stockout)

query: Do we have spare hydraulic pumps in stock for Press 1?

key_facts: Should query spare parts inventory filtered by compatible machine STP-01-PRS-HYP01
Part number SP-HYP-001 is the hydraulic pump cartridge
Should report quantity on hand, reorder point, and lead time

query: Are there any active equipment alerts right now?

key_facts: Should return list of current alerts with severity, machine, and description
Critical alerts should be highlighted first
